programme.title: Bachelor of Advanced Computing (Computer Science major) - RELATED
programme.degree: Bachelor of Advanced Computing, 4 years full-time, 192 credit points, CRICOS 093855E, intakes February and August; Computer Science is one of four Advanced Computing majors
programme.how_found: sydney.edu.au course search -> Bachelor of Advanced Computing; Engineering handbook -> Advanced Computing -> Majors -> Computer Science; figures from the 2027 International Admission Guide PDF.
programme.notes: RELATED, not the CS programme (owner ruling open): Sydney has no bachelor titled Computer Science; Computer Science is a major inside the Bachelor of Advanced Computing (and a Science shared-pool major). programme_status unknown. ACCESS NOTE: sydney.edu.au course pages render entry scores, fees and English requirements client-side (JavaScript); our fetcher reads only the title, so every figure here comes from static official pages and PDFs on sydney.edu.au. The kb list row has no official_domain; sydney.edu.au is the university's own domain (official site). robots.txt fetches occasionally failed with 'connection reset' and succeeded on retry.

english.notes: 2027 International Admission Guide, columns 'English - IELTS Academic' = 6.5 (6.0) and 'English - TOEFL iBT' = 85 (17/19). Matches the university standard on https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/applying/how-to-apply/international-students/english-language-requirements.html: 'The University's standard English language proficiency requirement is set at an IELTS overall score of 6.5 with no band below 6.0'. The faculty table (approved 11 November 2025) sets 7.0 (6.0) only for the combined Advanced Computing and Commerce degree.

gpa.notes: No GPA minimum. The 2027 International Admission Guide lists indicative admission scores for B Advanced Computing: International ATAR 90, IB Diploma 34 (and national equivalents such as USA - SAT 1340); 'All scores published are indicative only'. Not a published minimum.

deadline.quote: Application closing date Semester 1 (Feb) 1 December of the year prior to commencement
deadline.notes: International students, undergraduate, applying directly to the University: Semester 1 (February 2027) closes 1 December 2026; Semester 2 (August) '29 May of the commencing year'. Students taking an Australian Year 12 or an IB diploma in Australia apply through UAC instead.

tuition.notes: Column '2027 indicative Year 1 tuition fee ($AUD)/1.0 EFTSL'; 'Tuition fees are subject to annual increases'. The fees page gives the same faculty figure: 'Engineering and computer science ... Full-time fees (guide for 2027 entry) Undergraduate ... A$63,600' (https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/fees-and-loans/international-student-tuition-fees.html).

scholarship_exists.quote: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship This prestigious scholarship is valued at up to $60,000 and awarded on academic merit to exceptional international students to pursue coursework studies.
scholarship_exists.notes: International Guide 'Applying for 2027 entry' (PDF). Merit-based and competitive; 'up to $60,000' total value - partial tuition, not a full ride. The Sydney International Student Award is also named in the guide. The scholarship web pages render client-side.
